title: GUITION ESP32-S31 development kit features 7-inch capacitive touch display, Ethernet port

content:
After the Waveshare ESP32-S31-Touch-LCD-4.3C and VIEWE PLCM-UES31S043H800V480C-U, the GUITION JC1060F570C is another ESP32-S31 development kit with an integrated 7-inch touchscreen display. Some companies might reconsider the way they name their product… Leaving that aside, the GUITION devkit is especially interesting as it features a large 7-inch capacitive display compared to the 4.3-inch panels used in the other two models, and it’s the first to make use of the native Ethernet interface from the ESP32-S31 SoC. GUITION JC1060F570C_I_W_Y specifications: Wireless module – ESP32-S31-WROOM-3-N16R16V SoC – ESP32-S31NRV16 CPU RISC-V HP (High-performance) RV32IMAFCP CPU @ 320 MHz with FPU, SIMD, etc. RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core Memory – 512 KB SRAM, 32 KB low-power SRAM, 16MB PSRAM Wireless – 2.4 GHz WiFi 6 (802.11ax) Bluetooth 5.4 with support for LE Audio, direction finding, Bluetooth Mesh 1.1, and Classic (BR/EDR) 802.15.4 radio for Zigbee, Thread, and Matter Storage – 16 MB flash Antenna – PCB [...]
